name: FileBrowser image preview
description:
1. **Context menu copy actions** — added "Copy path" / "Copy relative path" to `ContextMenu.vue`, wired in `FileExplorer.vue`, with project-name-prefixed relative paths, multi-select (one path per line) and clipboard + toast feedback.
2. **FileViewer `jpeg` bug** — the root cause was calling the text `read` endpoint for media/binary files; `loadFile()` now skips it for inline previews (image/video/audio/pdf) and binary files.
3. **Extension audit** — new `src/utils/fileTypes.js` centralizes every extension list (JPEG aliases, TIFF/HEIC/AVIF, office/archive/font binaries), removed the wrong `ts`/`mts` video entries and duplicate icon keys, and `FileExplorer` reuses the same lists so thumbnails match the viewer.
4. **File events** — new `src/utils/fileEvents.js` detects backend payloads by `file_path` + `type` (not by socket name), normalizes them, and exposes a subscribe/publish bus; `session.onEvent` publishes them after resolving `data.project`.
5. **Reactive refresh** — `FileExplorer` subscribes on mount, ignores other projects and subfolder-only changes via `isDirectoryAffected`, and reloads the listing with a 400 ms debounce, skipped while loading or marquee-dragging.

messages.content: Add file preview mode in the file browser so we can see images, pdfs, video... and other formats with preview

I'll explore the file browser components and how file content is currently rendered before proposing changes.Let me read the current FileViewer, TabManager and the files API to understand how content is fetched and how to serve raw binary files.I now have a clear picture. `FileViewer.vue` already renders PDFs, images, videos and markdown, but the explorer itself has no way to *see* those files — you must open each one blind. And audio (and other binary formats) still fall through to the text highlighter. ## 1. Review & Understand the Task - Add a **preview mode** to the file browser so files can be recognized visually (images, video, PDF, audio…). - Keep list and grid views untouched; preview is a third presentation mode. - Everything else (open in tab, multi‑select, marquee, drag & drop, context menu) must keep working in the new mode. - Full‑size preview must not regress: audio needs a real player, and unsupported binaries must offer a download instead of a dead end. ## 2. Information gathered - `FileExplorer.vue` → `viewMode: 'list' | 'grid'`, `toggleViewMode()`, entries carry absolute `file_path`. - `$api.files.getFilePreviewUrl(path)` already exists (`/api/files/download?path=…&inline=true`) and is same‑origin safe for `img`/`video`/`iframe`/`audio`. - `FileViewer.vue` has `isPdf / isImage / isVideo / isMarkdown` branches but **no audio** branch; images went through base64 (`read`), which is fragile for large files. ## 3. Changes Summary | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` | Third `preview` view mode (thumbnails), cycling toggle, preview helpers + error fallback | | `src/components/filebrowser/FileViewer.vue` | Audio player branch, images served by streaming URL, explicit “no preview” card with download | ### FileExplorer.vue — preview mode - `toggleViewMode()` cycles `list → grid → preview → list`; button icon/title now derived from `nextViewMode`. - New constants `IMAGE_/VIDEO_/AUDIO_/PDF_PREVIEW_EXTENSIONS` (local, no new file needed — `getFileIcon` already lives here). - New methods: `getPreviewKind`, `previewUrl`, `videoThumbUrl`, `onPreviewError`, `hasPreviewError`, `fileTypeLabel`. - New template branch: square tiles, `object-cover` thumbnails (`loading="lazy"`), `

messages.content: FileViewer fails with "jpeg" images, check for other possible "extension name" errors that are missing

 */
function _send(API, method, url, data) {

    case 'GET':
      return API.connection.get(url)
    case 'DEL':
      return API.connection.del(url)
    case 'POST':
      return API.connection.post(url, data)
    case 'PUT':
      return API.connection.put(url, data)
    case 'DELETE':
      return API.connection.delete(url)
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsupported method ${method}`)
  }
